The team is in Greece and battles Team Excalibur, who have many tricks up their sleeves to cause devastating damage.
The team has problems working together and is helped by Team Wang Hu Zhong in the art of cooperation.
Kyoya travels to Savannah and must prevent anyone from beating him for 24 hours to advance.
The team travels to India and witness India's Team Chandora battle Africa's Team Wild Fang.
Back in Japan, Masamune challenges Nile, but his bravado cannot save him.
Enchantra comes to town for her Annual Witch Evaluation test.
It’s summer vacation. So many places to see… But Hilda wants the gang to go on an Adventure Tour in the Netherworld.
Harvey is recruited to test a prototype of a new virtual reality game.
Sabrina’s abuses her magic one too may times and Quigley is not pleased.
It is field trip time as Sabrina’s class heads toward Monument Island where an important statue is kept.

The effects of the full moon turns Emma into a carefree, wild mermaid. At her father’s birthday party she’s the opposite to her usual, organised self. Can the other girls stop her before all is revealed?
A charismatic newcomer, Dr. Denman, tempts Lewis with the promise of scientific fame and fortune. Will he abandon his friends and risk their secret, all in the name of science?
Rikki uses her abilities as a mermaid to earn some quick cash, but when she accidentally becomes involved in a fish smuggling operation, she sets out to get her revenge.

Rikki enters a short film contest on the theme of 'Heroes' and decides to capture some nice underwater footage with her 'abilities'. Meanwhile, Emma is interviewing her mum and Zane and Lewis are planning to rennact Dr. Bennet's windsurfing record.

Byron asks Emma for help with training the school's swimming team and Emma has some trouble deciding whether or not to help out in her current situation. Meanwhile, Lewis continues to experiment on the girls, which annoys Rikki.
Marshall must save his family from the clutches of a body snatchers--like cult of kitchenware fanatics who preserve their children by sealing them into human sized tupperware.
After obtaining a retainer that allows Marshall and his friends to hear what dogs are thinking, the boys learn that the animals are planning a revolution to take over Eerie.
Self-centered and conceited Prince Charming has only two goals in life: to look maahvelous, daaahling, and to reach the castle of Sleeping Beauty in order to kiss her out of her spell.
Craig and William are just about the only two people left who care about Rottmuckers Wax Museum and its collection of classic monsters.
Young Peters birthday is coming up, and he's looking forward to spending the weekend with his overworked father, a scientist at the local museum.

On a white wintry day, Vonderland celebrates, “Festivus Solarus." Verne becomes smitten with a pretty young, visiting Spanish astrologer, who snubs him when she realizes he is a Mortie. Verne feels like a misfit in both worlds, magic and Mortie.

ELSA, a young Giantess, becomes the newest student at the school and Cassy's roommate. ZARLAK takes control over LUCREZIA'S mind through a magic gemstone. He uses her to make it look like Cassy is tormenting Elsa, who finally runs away.
Scott has to watch over Grandpa for the weekend while Grandma is out of town, but it's the same weekend as the school picnic. Grandpa tags along with Scott and his friends, leaving Scott embarrassed.

The werewolf mascot costume is stolen by the uppity Upson High boys, right before the big game. Scott and Stiles must outsmart the snobbish Upson boys in order to retrieve the costume, or they'll have to find a new mascot entirely.
A werewolf hunter comes to the town of Wolverton. Scott and his family must find and warn Grandpa, who is hunting turkey in the woods.
Scott tries to earn money to pay for an electric guitar. He helps at his dad's shop, but finds raising money is a lot more difficult than he expected.
Scott and his family mysteriously become unable to control their wolf-outs and worry that the town monster, that has been covered in recent news reports, is actually them.
Moose is close to being cut from the football team unless he is able to bring his grades up.

Archie and the gang get a taste of what it's like to deal with teenagers when Mr. Weatherbee, Mr. Lodge and Miss Grundy drink bottles of contaminated water, causing them to revert to their wild teenage selves.

'Icy Pink': The Panther travels to Alaska to help an entrepreneurial Eskimo open up an ice cream factory. 'The End of Superpink': Super Pink has to prove to a little boy and his cat that it's brains, not brawn that determine a real superhero.

'All For Pink And Pink For All': Pinky, the Ant and Aardvark must save the Queen from the clutches of the evil Richelieu. 'Service With A Pink': An unscrupulous hotel boss forces Bellboy Panther to enter the wrestling ring with a vicious wrestler.

Robotnik introduces the "Ultra Freeze-O-Matic", announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install "Servitude Chips"into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.
Robotnik is after the Power Gems from the city of Submerbia in the Labyrinth Zone. Sonic and Tails are enlisted by a local citizen to stop Robotnik.
M.A.D. agents sabotage a U.S. space shuttle by planting a bomb on board. Inspector Gadget foils M.A.D.'s plans and saves the space shuttle.
While on a trip to Africa, Inspector Gadget, Penny, and Brain suspect that M.A.D. agents are using wild animals to scare off villagers and set up a crime base in the jungle.
Mr. Bean has painted his room bright green. But will Mrs. Wicket approve? Mr. Bean is painting a picture of Teddy when he accidentally squirts some green paint onto his brown wallpaper.

Mr. Bean becomes an accidental wrestling champion – with a little help from two little old ladies. Mr. Bean is no fan of wrestling. But he’s promised to take Mrs. Wicket and her friend Mrs. Wince to a big wrestling match in town.
Mr. Bean loves bird spotting and is desperate to tick off the last elusive bird in his book. Mr. Bean needs to see a very rare bird so he can tick off every page in his bird-spotting book.

Mr. Bean finds himself babysitting a baboon. Mr. Bean visits a safari park and comes home with more than a souvenir postcard. A cheeky young monkey hides inside Bean’s car smuggles himself out of the park.
Mr. Bean challenges Irma to a game of golf – inside his flat. Mr. Bean fancies a game of golf so he creates his own golf course inside his flat, and invites Irma to join him for a round.
Rip, Cyril, and Sam travel to Cairo, Egypt to investigate the case of a woman put in a coma by the Curse of King Tut, after trying to buy contraband artifacts from the dead Pharaoh's tomb.
